assessment_objectives.objective: upon return from travel to authoritarian countries, the issued temporary, loaner or "travel-only" end user technology (e.g., laptops and mobile devices) is wiped / re-imaged before being re-issued.
organization-defined security requirements are applied to the system or system components when the individuals return from travel.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at a minimum, re-imaging from a known-good baseline before the device is reconnected to an internal network or re-issued

assessment_objectives.objective: the following security requirements are applied to the system or system components when the individuals return from travel: <A.03.04.12.ODP[02]: security requirements>.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: examine the system for signs of physical tampering and take the appropriate actions, and then either purge and reimage all storage media or destroy the system
assessment_objectives.org_defined_parameters: US DoD ODP Value: examine the system for signs of physical tampering and take the appropriate actions, and then either purge and reimage all storage media or destroy the system
